item.title: These 2 Tennessee Lawmakers Want to Charge You With Homicide for Getting an Abortion
item.description: The proposed legislation would revise the state’s criminal code to charge abortion patients with fetal homicide, a crime punishable by life imprisonment, life without parole, or, yes, the death penalty.

item.title: It’s Been Almost Two Months Since the U.S. Invaded a Country. Is It Iran’s Turn to Be a Trump Distraction?
item.description: Trump claimed the nuclear program of Iran was "obliterated." Now, 8 months later it's "a week away" from having nuclear bombs. Okay, sure.

item.title: Splinter: America Is a Hockey Country Now
item.description: Hockey is for everyone; the guy who scored the golden American goal firmly believes it, so don't let any dipshit Tkachuck bro tell you otherwise.

item.title: Kristi Noem Made Up a Story About Deporting a Cannibal
item.description: Over the summer, the Secretary of Homeland Security peddled a falsehood about a man on a deportation flight who tried to “eat his own arms.”

item.title: Women’s U.S. Hockey Shows How to Celebrate Olympic Gold Without Kash Patel
item.description: After winning Olympic gold, the men's team partied with Patel and got an invite to the State of the Union from Trump, who said he’d “probably be impeached” if he didn’t invite the women’s team.

item.title: U.S. women's hockey team gets enthusiastic party invite from Flavor Flav
item.description: After declining to attend Trump's State Of The Union address, the gold medalists have received a flexible invite to party in Las Vegas.

item.title: Sole Witness to Texas ICE Killing of an American Citizen Also Died this Weekend
item.description: Joshua Orta was reportedly "planning" to testify about his friend's killing by ICE, before he died this weekend himself, in a car wreck.

item.title: Hilary Duff Has Spoken
item.description: You could even say she is <em>coming clean&nbsp;</em>about the toxic mom group drama. Except not really, since it doesn't seem like it phased her at all.

item.title: The Guy Suing a California Doctor for Allegedly Sending Abortion Pills Into Texas Has a History of Violence Against Women
item.description: Jerry Rodriguez has been convicted of attacking or harassing at least two women and was arrested in 2025 for allegedly beating and strangling a third woman.

item.title: Every Day, the Chocolate We Eat Gets Worse. Some of It Is No Longer “Chocolate.”
item.description: Even as the price of chocolate returns to lower levels, companies are realizing something scary: Americans will buy their fake chocolate.
